material_novelty: new empty-start dated colonization state with persistent breeding-system response
reason: New island provides an unusually explicit source/colonization chronology: Honckenya arrived in 1967, early population size and pollinator limitation are reconstructed, source populations are measured directly, and current sex-morph plus seed response is measured. Historical arrival of the focal small generalist pollinator is not itself dated by a matched direct observation, so the transition coordinate remains incomplete.

Three-to-four-year orchid demography includes direct flowering, fruiting, recruitment and population decline on Saba; hawkmoth pollinators are locally reported rather than measured in the focal Saba flowers, and no historical turnover coordinate is available.

reason: Five-day on-island observations recorded bees visiting Abutilon pitcairnense, while ex-situ self/cross work and conservation propagation establish reproductive feasibility. The pollinator observations and reproductive experiment are not one matched island transition-response unit.

source_reference: Rousseau et al. 2009, Existe-t-il un transport pollinique vers Clipperton?; Clipperton terrestrial flora synthesis
reason: Atmospheric filters directly demonstrate long-distance pollen arrival from the Americas, but this is abiotic pollen transport rather than a measured animal-pollinator transition and is not linked to local plant reproductive response.

Parker Point on Rottnest has direct flower, fruit, pollination-success and mating-system measurements, but Posidonia is hydrophilous. This is useful as an assurance/pollen-limitation control, not evidence for the focal animal-partner turnover mechanism.

material_novelty: new documented partner reintroduction plus direct functional pollination test and compensatory-community result
reason: Hihi were deliberately established on Tiritiri Matangi in 1995-1996; in the later experiment they supplied 67% of observed avian visits to hangehange at the Auckland hihi+ site, and exclusion treatments measured fruit and seed consequences. The study directly tests whether translocation restored pollination and finds compensation by other birds, but lacks a matched pre-reintroduction plant functional state/outcome and therefore does not close the full source-state to transition to realization to response contract.
